package.description: A graphical user interface (GUI) that controls the data acquisition for the QEPAS-CH4 methane sensor.

en-US.description: A graphical user interface (GUI) that controls the data acquisition for the QEPAS-CH4 methane sensor.
en-US.longDescription: The software package for Thorlabs' Quart-Enhanced Photoacoustic Sensor is a graphical user interface (GUI) that controls the data acquisition for the QEPAS-CH4 methane sensor. This user-friendly GUI allows the user to set measurement parameters, measure methane concentrations, and perform statistical analysis on the data. A Data Viewer within the software can be used to view and analyze data from a previously saved measurement.
en-US.name: QEPAS

zh-CN.description: 用于控制 QEPAS-CH4 甲烷传感器数据采集的图形用户界面 (GUI) 软件包。
zh-CN.longDescription: Thorlabs 石英增强光声传感器配套软件包是一个用于控制 QEPAS-CH4 甲烷传感器数据采集的图形用户界面 (GUI)。用户界面简单好用，支持设置测量参数、检测甲烷浓度以及对数据进行统计分析。软件内置的数据查看器可调阅并分析历史保存的测量数据。
